{
  "modules": ["./colorize.tsx"],
  "description": "Recolor the terminal tab/background by Claude Code session state",
  "hooks": {
    "SessionStart":       [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "\"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run.sh\" hook", "timeout": 5 }] }],
    "UserPromptSubmit":   [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "\"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run.sh\" hook", "timeout": 5 }] }],
    "PostToolUse":        [{ "matcher": "*", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "\"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run.sh\" hook", "timeout": 5 }] }],
    "PostToolUseFailure": [{ "matcher": "*", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "\"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run.sh\" hook", "timeout": 5 }] }],
    "Notification":       [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "\"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run.sh\" hook", "timeout": 5 }] }],
    "Stop":               [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "\"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run.sh\" hook", "timeout": 5 }] }],
    "StopFailure":        [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "\"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run.sh\" hook", "timeout": 5 }] }],
    "SessionEnd":         [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "\"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run.sh\" hook", "timeout": 5 }] }]
  }
}
